prompts.front: Use case: precise sprite-animation edit. Edit this EXISTING transparent 1536x1024 atlas for the SAME silver-haired crossbowman, front view. It has 3 columns and 2 rows, each cell 512x512. ONLY TOP ROW is the edit target. The BOTTOM ROW is unchanged reference: bottom-left = lowered idle, bottom-middle = fully raised aim, bottom-right = firing. Replace the three identical TOP ROW idle poses with THREE GENUINE IN-BETWEEN DRAWINGS of raising this exact crossbow: TOP LEFT 25% raised, TOP MIDDLE 50% raised, TOP RIGHT 75% raised, progressing smoothly between the two bottom reference poses. Arms bend naturally at shoulders and elbows, keeping both hands attached to the SAME crossbow with an invariant length, thickness, stock, limbs and strings. Keep torso, arms and weapon as one coherent drawing. No teleport, motion blur, pose blending, stretchy arms, distorted crossbow or two weapons. Preserve original character design, hair, face, amber eyes, skin, black/white costume, orange scarf, shading, SD head/body ratio and native hand sizes. Head, torso center and feet stay at EXACT same position and scale in each existing cell; do not change face/head pose or foot placement. Edit only the arm/crossbow arrangement needed for the in-betweens. Keep original 3/4 front orientation. Do not redraw or reposition bottom reference cells. Retain every original cell boundary, 1536x1024 canvas, transparent background and crisp sprite rendering. No text, grid, fake checkerboard, floor or extra items. This is modifying existing game art, not creating a new character.

Image 2 is a POSITION GUIDE only: its red crosses mark where each TOP ROW crossbow muzzle should end. Do not copy the red marks or gray background. The top muzzles should end near the guide's red crosses, approximately native sprite coordinates (202,227), (207,219), (212,213), advancing gently toward the bottom-middle aim endpoint. No top weapon may protrude farther right than the bottom-middle reference weapon. Preserve the original crossbow design and rigid physical proportions with correct rear-view perspective, both hands gripping it. Bend elbows and shoulders smoothly; no disconnection, stretching, extra limbs, weapon duplicates or giant arm. Keep the original head, torso, hip and foot positions and sizes exactly fixed in each cell; retain silver hair, black/white outfit and orange scarf. Bottom row stays unchanged. Match existing SD rendering, crisp contours and colors. Genuine transparent alpha outside sprites, no glow, halo, gradient, blur, shadow, text or grid. Exact same atlas size and layout. This is modifying existing character art, not a new character.

scope: Three intermediate body/arms/crossbow drawings per direction. Native head, lower feet and source pixels outside the upper-body edit mask are preserved; all original inputs retained.
